scope_note: This manifest freezes the structural 37-method public scope without claiming uniform runtime availability, validation depth, or redistribution clearance.

state_definitions.historical_evidence: The repository contains an implementation narrative, but the referenced raw validation artifacts are not distributed and the claim is not independently verifiable from a public clone.
state_definitions.partial: The alignment narrative itself records incomplete coverage, a missing fresh rerun, proxy-only evidence, a missing source/checkpoint, or a restricted evaluation path.

runtime_state_definitions.not_assessed: Runtime availability has not been fully assessed; no clean-clone blocker was established beyond the separately recorded evidence and license limitations.
runtime_state_definitions.blocked_by_undistributed_assets: The canonical path requires local assets, checkpoints, support sets, or datasets that are not distributed with the repository.
runtime_state_definitions.blocked_by_optional_dependency: The canonical implementation imports or requires a project extra that a core installation does not provide.
runtime_state_definitions.network_dependent: The canonical path may download a model or other external artifact when it is absent locally.
